AIDEN.text: Vegas. After the homecoming. I had been back long enough for these niggas to start charging admission to my problems. Somebody had put angel wings on a photograph of me getting arrested. Cropped out the cuffs, left the officer’s hand on my shoulder. Nigga had a police escort into heaven.
AIDEN.source: The Niggatorial Tellings, Book I, chapter 1, paragraphs at source lines 21 and 23; consecutive prose, unchanged words.
AIDEN.direction: An adult American male with a deep resonant baritone. Natural African American English conversational cadence, relaxed phrasing, warm chest resonance and a slight grain to the voice. Clear words in a close, clean studio recording.

TANK.text: We gathered here because my brother would want these niggas supporting the bar. Aiden was generous. Nigga gave me the shirt off his back.
TANK.source: The Niggatorial Tellings, Book I, chapter 1, Tank's exact dialogue at lines 149 and 153. Narration and crowd action between the lines omitted only for this isolated casting sample.
